title: Couple matcher corpus manifest
description: PLAN-AUDIO-MATCHING-PREWORK §10.1. One split's cases + ground truth. Media MAY be gitignored; this manifest MUST be committed. Synthetic cases carry a `gen` block (the committed generation parameters) so their pcm media is reproducible without committing WAVs; real cases reference repo-relative media under `mediaRoot`.

split.description: The split governs the tuning rule (§10.3/§10.5): holdout is NEVER tuned on; calibration and validation hold real difficult examples (a given recording event lives in exactly one split — no event leakage).

mediaRoot.description: Repo-relative root the real `a`/`b` paths resolve against (empty ⇒ the repo root). Ignored for synthetic cases (they regenerate from `gen`).

group.description: synthetic | calibration | validation | holdout | a real recording-event name.

a.description: Video/camera side: a repo-relative media path (real) or generated file name (synthetic).

b.description: External-audio side: a repo-relative media path (real) or generated file name (synthetic).

sameEvent.description: Ground truth: do a and b capture the SAME acoustic event? A false case MUST NOT confidently match.

expectedOffsetMs.description: A→B lag: content at time t in a occurs at t + expectedOffsetMs/1000 in b.

expectedDriftPpm.description: Clock drift of b relative to a, ppm.

minimumOverlapS.description: The overlap the case is constructed to present; scoring expects the matcher to be reachable at/above the pairing floor.

tags.description: Family/condition tags; drive the per-tag metrics breakdown.

allowedForTuning.description: MUST be false for every holdout case (§10.1). Thresholds are never tuned on a case with allowedForTuning=false.

gen.description: Synthetic generation parameters (absent for real cases). pcm WAV only (no video, no AAC) so regeneration is byte-stable.

camSeedOffset.description: Nonzero ⇒ the camera master differs from the external (independent fine content, same macro-envelope).
